name: Cry of the Thunderhawk
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
The thunderhawk, adventurer, is a fierce beast.  It is time for you to face them.  You must find where it roams, and bring me its wings as proof of your successful hunt.

Do this, and your time with me will near its end.
narrative.objectives: Find and slay a Thunderhawk, return its wings to Jorn Skyseer at Camp Taurajo.
narrative.offerRewardText:
You, like the thunderhawk, should be proud. You have bested every foe we set you before, and have done so with strength, courage and honor.

But your path, adventurer, continues. In fact, you will find that true hunters forever strive, forever walk their path with the same pride you have shown me.

Now, it is time to move on.
narrative.requestItemsText: Is it done? Have you slain the thunderhawk?
